limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: Identify yourself! Who are you? And where am I?
Woah, calm down! No need to get all fiesty. You wouldn't be able to harm me, even if you tried your hardest, y'know? Being a ghost, and all.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: What? A ghost? So I really am dead aren't I...?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Again, not quite! You seem to be in LIMBO

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: LIMBO?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Yes! LIMBO, a place between the world of the living and the afterlife!

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: So I am dead?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Well physically you are, but it seems that your SOUL is still living.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: B- but how?! Shouldn't this be the end for me?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Well it seems like although your physical self has given up, your SOUL is still determined to keep fighting. And it won't stop until it is satisfied.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: But how? If I'm physically dead, how can I continue fighting? Won't that mean I'm stuck in this void forever?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: It seems that way to me. But may I ask what is fueling this determination of yours?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: Well I am-... or atleast I was, cursed by something unknown, and was trying to find a cure to stop it from spreading..

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: But what does it matter to you anyway?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: It matters to me, because I might be able to get you back on your feet. But only for a small price of course

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: I'm not letting you control my body.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Not your body, silly. I do not care for some cursed human. What I do care about, however, are MARROW SHARDS.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: Marrow what now? What is that?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: MARROW SHARDS, they're fragments of a SOUL that grant strength to beings in the afterlife.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: These MARROW SHARDS leave a living being whenever they've been killed, and since you've experienced death before, you'll be able to see them and collect them.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: I'm willing to give you a second chance in life, by returning you back to the start of your journey, and in return you can collect these MARROW SHARDS and hand them to me.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: No deal.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: NO DEAL!?! This is a deal of a lifetime we're talking about! I can quite literally bring you back from the dead, and you DECLINE MY OFFER?!

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: Well, being resurrected won't do me any good if I just die over and over again. If I couldn't survive back then, I surely couldn't survive now.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: How about this then. When returning these MARROW SHARDS to me, when you inevitably come back, how about I lend you my strength? To aid you in your quest of finding your cure.

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: It does seem tempting...

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: Does that mean we have a deal?

limbo_intro_1.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_1.text: No deal. I won't help some strange ghost that I've just met

limbo_intro_1.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_1.text: You're no fun. Enjoy sitting here in pure silence then...

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: Yeah... about that.. is that deal still on the table?

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: I don't know... I don't really feel like making deals with people right now...

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: Especially not those with weird curses...

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: And who also wear super ugly knight's armo-

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: ALRIGHT ALRIGHT WE GET IT, I WAS WRONG!

limbo_intro_2.speaker: YOU
limbo_intro_2.text: I'll collect those shard things for you, so will you please resurrect me and lend me your strength?

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: You've got yourself a deal! Pleasure doin' business with ya!

limbo_intro_2.speaker: GHOST
limbo_intro_2.text: I'll open a portal for you, enter it and you'll be back in your very own cursed body!

ghost_greeting.speaker: GHOST
ghost_greeting.text: Back again, huh? Show me what you've got!
